name: Power Word Stun

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A creature with 150 HP or fewer is Stunned until it passes a Con save at the end of a turn; a tougher one has Speed 0 until your next turn.
text: No save at first: a target with 150 Hit Points or fewer has the Stunned condition and makes a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns, ending it on a success. A target with more Hit Points instead has Speed 0 until the start of your next turn.
